column1: # @[simp] lemmas no proof names but the proofs need. Each was removed, alone,
# from a copy of its model, and the copy no longer elaborates (one-shot probe:
# `lake env lean` on the copy, no lake cache, 2026-11-23); the twelve the
# probe showed dead are in deleted-theorems.tsv. audit-theorems.py counts
# these as used by a proof. The probe is not rerun in CI (each lemma costs one
# elaboration of its model, minutes in all): a lemma listed here that a later
# change makes unneeded stays exempt until someone re-probes it. To re-probe:
# copy the model, delete the lemma from the copy, run `lake env lean` on the
# copy from formal/ (not `lake build`, whose cache can hide the change), and
# drop the row (and delete the lemma, listing it in deleted-theorems.tsv) when
# the copy elaborates with no error or warning. Tab-separated: name, how it
